stem.text: Which statement is correct for the structure and function of this triglyceride?

A.text: The glycerol head forms hydrogen bonds with water in cytoplasm to produce oil droplets.

B.text: The hydrophobic fatty acids allow only small molecules to pass through the cell surface membrane.

C.text: It packs closely with identical triglyceride molecules to form energy reserves in lysosomes.

D.text: It has long hydrocarbon chains that release high energy output per unit mass when oxidised.
